name: Zombie Massacre
author: Addicting Games
description: Zombie Massacre is a zombie fighting a game set in the wild wild west. If it wasn’t tough already to be a cowboy, now you have to slaughter zombies while protecting the frightened and defenseless townspeople. Use your available weapons to kill as many zombies as possible. As you pass each stage, you’ll earn points and unlock weapons that you can purchase and then upgrade. You can also unlock support like medkits, ammo, and other supplies that can help you in this action game. During gameplay, you’ll find green boxes that hold new items that you can use. On your dashboard, click on the sheriff to view all the achievements that you have completed or are in progress. As you gain more achievements, you’ll also rise up in ranks. On top of keeping yourself safe, protect the townspeople and the wagon. If you protect the right person, they may reward you with supplies and coins.
